newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF MEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: The following is a profile of the winner of the men's giant slalom at the Alpine skiing world championships on Wednesday:
World Cup wins: 9. Giant slalom - Kranjska Gora (97), Alta Badia (96), Hinterstoder (96), Adelboden (96), Park City (95), Vail (95), Tignes (95), Val d'Isere (94), Veysonnaz (93)

Other facts: Bronze medallist in giant slalom and slalom at 1996 world championships in Sierra Nevada, Spain. Considered among the most technically sound and elegant skiers on the World Cup circuit. Orphaned as child after mother died of illness and father killed in a farming accident. Was raised by sister Christine who was also a member of the Swiss team. Lists Sweden's Ingemar Stenmark as his greatest influence.
